notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) HTTP-first via curl_cffi (impersonate=chrome), no robots.txt present (404, so no restriction). Category pages are server-side rendered (ASP.NET MVC, jQuery front end) - full product grid and a hidden pagination form field (id=TotalObjectCount) are present in the raw HTML response, so no Playwright/CDP needed. TREE: HVL Group is the holding-company storefront for Hudson Valley Lighting, Troy Lighting, Corbett Lighting, Mitzi, Schoolhouse, CSL and Sonneman; the homepage mega-menu has a full 'Textiles & Furnishings' top-level menu with two sub-groups - 'TEXTILES' (Bedding, Rugs & Runners, Throw Pillows, Shower Curtains) and 'FURNITURE' (Tables, Chairs & Stools, Bar Cart, Storage Carts, Storage Furniture, Beds) - plus a separate 'DECOR' sub-group under a different top menu containing Mirrors, Throw Pillows (dup link), Accessories, and Utility & Organization. Confirmed each candidate URL's identity via its category-specific filter facet (e.g. Bedding page's filter panel exposes BeddingSizeIDs facets for Queen/Full, Twin, Standard Sham, etc., proving the URL is the genuine Bedding listing and not a mis-slugged fallback). QTY: taken from the hidden pagination form field '<input id="TotalObjectCount" value="N">' embedded in each category page's own paging widget - this is the site's exact server-computed total product count for that route, cross-checked against the product-card count on paginated pages. EXCLUDED (Storage): 'Storage Carts' (13) and 'Storage Furniture' (31) - sampled contents are Lolly Bar Cart, Miller Storage Cart, Forma Cabinet, Miller Bookshelf, i.e. genuine furniture case-goods, and the website itself files both under its own 'FURNITURE' nav heading alongside Tables/Chairs/Beds/Bar Cart, not under any Storage heading - storage.md Sec.21/Sec.27 rule: prefer Furniture when the site explicitly places the product there. 'Utility & Organization' (65) - sampled all 65 product titles (Picture Ledge, Clare V Sonia/Yves Tray, J Hook, Knurled Hook, Mollie Hook, Perkins Hook, Remy Hook, Rhone Hook, Thomas Hook, Tula Hook, Stacking Tray Set, Torrey Wall Shelf); every item is a decorative wall hook, picture ledge, wall shelf, or decorative tray - none are boxes/bins/baskets/organizers/bags with a genuine storage function, and the site itself groups this category under its 'DECOR' nav heading, not under Storage/Furniture - storage.md Sec.24 (Decorative Bowls/Trays are NOT Storage) and the Wall Decor boundary in Sec.18 apply; excluded as decorative wall accessories, out of Storage scope entirely (zero genuine storage rows for this company). EXCLUDED (other, out of scope for this task): Beds, Seating, Bar-Cart, Tables (Furniture), Mirrors, Decorative-Accessories (Decor/Wall Decor), Bath-Hardware, Bath-and-Vanity, Knobs, Pulls, Wall-Hardware (Hardware), all lighting categories (Chandelier, Pendant, Flush-Mount, Wall-Sconce, Table-Lamp, Floor-Lamp, etc. - this is fundamentally a decorative lighting fixture company). /Products/Feature/Textiles and /Products/Feature/Decor are cross-brand editorial 'Feature' filter pages (not standalone nav categories), excluded per the Collections/View-All rule - their underlying content is already fully captured via the four real Textile category pages recorded below. No grouping row added for a top-level 'Textiles' node: Bedding/Rugs/Throw Pillows/Shower Curtains are flat sibling leaf categories in the nav with no shared parent landing page whose own count could be verified as their sum, so each is recorded as an independent leaf per the parent-URL rule.
